text: Why study in WU 1．One of the ”211 Project” and “985 Project” universities. 2．Long history traced back to the late Qing Dynasty. 3．Honored as the “Most Beautiful University in China.” 4．Cultivate more than 300 thousand professional talents in various occupations. 5．Scholarship is provided to the excellent student Program Highlight Teachers with rich backgrounds in consulting and business practices. Opportunities to interact directly with the most successful entrepreneurs and business people through MBA courses taught by management practitioners with rich experience. Program Introduction This program provides a holistic general management education with global perspective and Chinese feature. Teaching Objective To help student obtain knowledge and ability of business management, economic management and enterprise management, and enable student to deal with all kinds of business management related work in all kinds of organizations. Main Courses Principles of Management,macro-economics,Management Information System, Statistics, Accounting, Finance Management, Marketing,Economic Law,Human Resource Management,Enterprise Strategic Management. Fee Structure Tuition fee: 50000RMB/year Accommodation: Single room: 1200RMB/person/month Twin rooms: 600RMB/person/month A flat with 4 single rooms: 900RMB/person/month Deposit: 200RMB Textbooks: 200-1000RMB/year Living expenses : 10000-20000RMB/year In total：66400~83200RMB/year Internship Human resources, planning, purchasing or sales management in the enterprise. Duration 3 years Degree Awarded Master of Business Administration Future Career Banking, consultancy, accountancy, marketing, advertising, human resource management and general management. Teaching Facilities 5 state key laboratories, 2 national engineering research centers, 11 key laboratories at the level of the Ministry of Education, 5 engineering research centers at the level of the Ministry of Education, 7 key bases for humanities and social sciences research at the level of the Ministry of Education, 10 national bases for basic scientific research and talents cultivation, 9 national experimental teaching demonstration centers, 1 national base for cultural-quality-oriented education of university students, 48 key research bases at provincial and ministry level Teacher Highlight 1139 professors, 1258 associate professors, 7 academicians from the Chinese Academy of Sciences, and 8 academicians from Chinese Academy of Engineering.
